title: 第二百二十六章 一人增援第二百二十五章 先拔头筹
lines: 第二百二十六章一人增援
夜天云虽然表面上毫不在意，但心中所想与水门却是一致的。
如今虽然他们先拔头筹，但战过才知道这场战斗并不容易。
沙忍虽然折损了一千人，但精锐部队并没有损耗，所谓战争便是如此，无数的炮灰铸就了胜利。
而这一千人便是炮灰。
木叶的增援一时三刻是无法到达，毕竟沙忍的动作太快，当木叶得知开战之时沙忍的部队已经向风火两国的边境开拔，三代火影就算是有天大的本事一时间也不可能凑出与沙忍相同的人数。
因此，夜天云心中才担忧。
他担忧的不是他和水门的安全，面对着三千沙忍，他们完全有能力自保，但自保有何用！？
夜天云可以撤回，水门用飞雷神之术也可以带着玖辛奈卡卡西等人离开，那剩下的忍者怎么办？他们的任务是守住边境，若是火之国边境被破，沙忍便可以畅通无阻的在火之国境内穿梭，届时夜天云就算是有通天的本事也挡不住源源不断的沙忍，届时木叶最算是与沙忍决战胜利，受损的还不是火之国的土地？丢失的还不是火之国的物资？
至于凭着夜天云和水门二人之力将敌人全歼，夜天云想都没想过。
三千忍者，没有大范围杀伤性忍术的水门要用多少次飞雷神？！而夜天云要用多少次螺旋手里剑，豪火灭却，甚至是惊鸿一类的招式？为减少伤害要维持多久的紫雷战铠？就算是夜天云隐遁在空间中，在那维持幽夜能力的半小时时限中，他要用多少次瞬步？做多少次瞬间攻击？
夜天云和水门也是人，也会受伤，何况沙忍的许多苦无都涂了毒素，只要受到一点儿伤，即便没有生命伤害，动作也必然会迟缓一些，然后。。夜天云相信面对上千忍者的包围，他也就没有然后了。
时间已经过了一日，夜天云端坐在主营帐中，眼中闪过一丝忧色，而身边的玖辛奈只是静静的站着，她也注意到了夜天云的忧心，因此本来活泼的她此时也不发一声。
“玖辛奈，红和红豆他们如何了。”沉吟了一会儿，夜天云开口问道。
玖辛奈淡淡一笑，继而道：“没事了，见过一次下次就会好的。”
“那就好。”夜天云脸上的忧色缓了一缓。
“讨厌鬼，遇到麻烦了？”玖辛奈轻声问道。
夜天云沉默了一会儿，也就不在隐瞒，轻声说道：“人数毕竟处于劣势，沙忍的援军不久就会到达，只能走一步看一步了，大不了我孤身闯入敌营，将对方的精英忍者杀的一干二净，相信沙忍也就不攻自破了。”夜天云的眼神中闪过一丝寒光。
孤身闯入敌营，这是不是办法的办法，若是在战场上正面交锋，夜天云很难使用大范围的忍术，在木叶忍者人数处于极度劣势的情况下，正面交战着实不利。
“不可以，我不允许你这么做！！”玖辛奈大叫道。
“你放心，此时沙忍中没有能挡得住我的高手，而且你也知道我可以隐遁在空间中，就算行踪暴露而被围攻也绝对可以自保。”
第二百二十六章一人增援
“那也不可以！”玖辛奈的语气不容置疑，眼中满是惶惧的神色。
看着如此激动的玖辛奈，夜天云心中感动，轻轻的吻了下玖辛奈的脸颊，柔声道：“放心吧，不到万不得已我不会去的。”
玖辛奈狠狠的抱住了夜天云，语气中竟带有一丝哭腔：“我不管，无论你的实力到了何等地步，无论你做了多少保证，无论你有多少把握，你都不许去！”
夜天云心中感动，也抱住了玖辛奈，两人不发一声。
而此时，营帐的帘子被掀开。
“天云师兄，你看谁。。”水门一脸欢喜的走了进来，不过看着拥抱在一起的两人，脸上露出了一丝尴尬之色。
夜天云倒是很大方的松开了玖辛奈，脸上露出一丝疑惑：“怎么了，水门？”
水门淡淡一笑：“你看谁来了！”话音刚落，营帐中的门帘再度被掀开。
“鹿久大哥！”夜天云的眼中也闪过一丝喜色。
“哈哈，天云，怎么样，想不到是我吧。”鹿久也是满脸笑容的说道。
“看来刚才打扰你们的好事了。”鹿久淡淡的说道，不过眼神却在玖辛奈和夜天云只见流转，调侃之意甚盛。
“喂，鹿久大哥，看什么看，没见过两口子亲热吗？”玖辛奈的脸上挂着微笑，眼睛半眯，但眼神中却隐隐透出一股寒光。
看着如此彪悍的玖辛奈，夜天云不禁呛了一下，鹿久脸上的笑意也僵在那里，干笑了一声：“没事了，没事了。”
“哼。”玖辛奈冷哼一声，继而说道：“你们谈正事，我去看看红豆她们。”
随即玖辛奈离开了营帐。
“这个玖辛奈。。”夜天云轻叹了一声，无奈的摇了摇头，随即脸上现出一抹笑意，轻声说道：“鹿久大哥这次来想必是做了不少的功课吧。”
“哈哈。”奈良鹿久大笑一声，继而道：“不愧是暗影幽蝶，一语中的。”
夜天云笑了下，摇了摇头，脸上现出一抹自嘲的神色，语气中也透着些许的无奈：“让我执行绝密任务，让我击杀敌方的强者，我没有问题，但若是让我指挥大部队忍者作战，而且还是以少打多的情况下，我除了孤身闯入敌营外没有任何办法了。”
“论战斗力，我强于鹿久大哥，但论指挥能力，我远远逊于你啊。”
鹿久也不是做作之人，也就淡淡一笑，算是认下了。
“唉，天云，水门，我这次来就是来帮助你们的，不过现在村中忙做一团，因为据情报云忍那边也不安分了，为了防止出现同沙忍战斗时因准备不足而人手吃紧的状况，火影大人已经开始着手于与云忍的战前准备了。”
“不过火影大人依旧放心不下你们，因此当我刚刚料理完族内事务时便被派到这里了。”
夜天云轻叹了口气，不过还是笑了下：“理当如此，不过有了鹿久大哥，我们也可称得上有了强力援军了。”

Chapter 226: One person reinforcement
Although Ye Tianyun didn't care on the surface, his thoughts were the same as Minato's.
Although they are taking the lead now, they know after fighting that this battle is not easy.
Although the Sand Ninjas lost a thousand people, the elite troops were not attrited. This is what the so-called war is like. Countless cannon fodder creates victory.
And these thousand people are cannon fodder.
Konoha's reinforcements would not be able to arrive for a while. After all, the sand ninjas moved too fast. When Konoha learned that the war started, the sand ninja's troops had already moved towards the border between the two countries of wind and fire. Even if the third generation Hokage had great ability, it would be impossible to gather the same number of people as the sand ninjas in a short period of time.
Therefore, Ye Tianyun was worried.
What he was worried about was not his and Minato's safety. Facing three thousand sand ninjas, they were fully capable of protecting themselves, but what was the use of protecting themselves! ?
Ye Tianyun can withdraw, and Minato can use the Flying Thunder God Technique to leave with Kushina, Kakashi and others, but what about the remaining ninjas? Their mission is to guard the border. If the border of the Fire Country is breached, the Sand Ninja can travel unimpeded within the Fire Country. By then, even if Ye Tianyun has Tongtian's ability, he will not be able to stop the continuous flow of Sand Ninja. By then, Konoha will finally win the decisive battle with the Sand Ninja. Isn't it the land of the Fire Country that will be damaged? Wasn’t the lost material belonging to the Kingdom of Fire?
As for using the power of Ye Tianyun and Minato to annihilate all the enemies, Ye Tianyun never thought about it.
With three thousand ninjas, how many times would Minato use the Flying Thunder God without a large-scale destructive ninjutsu? ! And how many times does Ye Tianyun need to use the spiral shuriken, the powerful fire extinguisher, or even the Jinghong type of moves? How long should the purple thunder armor be maintained to reduce damage? Even if Ye Tianyun is hiding in space, how many times will he use Shunpo in the half-hour time limit to maintain You Ye's ability? How many instant attacks do you make?
Ye Tianyun and Minato are also human beings, and they will also be injured. What's more, many kunai of Sand Ninja are coated with poison. As long as they are slightly injured, even if there is no life damage, their movements will inevitably be slower, and then. . Ye Tianyun believed that faced with being surrounded by thousands of ninjas, there was nothing he could do.
One day had passed. Ye Tianyun was sitting in the main camp tent, with a hint of worry in her eyes. Kushina beside her just stood quietly. She also noticed Ye Tianyun's worry, so she, who was originally lively, did not say a word at this time.
"Kushina, how are Hong and Anko?" After pondering for a while, Ye Tianyun asked.
Kushina smiled faintly and then said: "It's okay. I'll see you once and you'll be fine next time."
"That's good." The worry on Ye Tianyun's face eased.
"You bastard, are you in trouble?" Kushina asked softly.
Ye Tianyun was silent for a while, no longer hiding anything, and said softly: "After all, we are at a disadvantage in terms of numbers. The Sand Ninja's reinforcements will arrive soon. We can only take one step at a time. At worst, I will break into the enemy camp alone and kill all the elite ninjas on the other side. I believe that the Sand Ninja will defeat itself." A cold light flashed in Ye Tianyun's eyes.
Breaking into the enemy camp alone is not a solution. If there is a head-on confrontation on the battlefield, it will be difficult for Ye Tianyun to use a wide range of ninjutsu. With the number of Konoha ninjas at an extreme disadvantage, a head-on battle is really disadvantageous.
"No, I don't allow you to do this!!" Kushina yelled.
"Don't worry, there is no master among the sand ninjas who can stop me at this time, and you also know that I can hide in space. Even if my whereabouts are exposed and I am besieged, I can definitely protect myself."
Chapter 226: One person reinforcement
"That's not possible!" Kushina's tone was unquestionable, with a look of fear in her eyes.
Seeing such an excited Kushina, Ye Tianyun was moved, kissed Kushina's cheek gently, and said softly: "Don't worry, I won't go unless I have to."
Kushina hugged Ye Tianyun fiercely, with a hint of crying in her tone: "I don't care, no matter how strong you are, no matter how many guarantees you make, no matter how sure you are, you are not allowed to go!"
Ye Tianyun was moved in his heart and hugged Kushina too, without saying a word.
At this time, the curtain of the tent was opened.
"Senior Brother Tianyun, who are you looking at..." Minato walked in with a happy face, but looking at the two people hugging each other, there was a hint of embarrassment on his face.
Ye Tianyun let go of Kushina generously, with a trace of confusion on his face: "What's wrong, Minato?"
Minato smiled lightly: "Look who's here!" As soon as he finished speaking, the door curtain in the tent was opened again.
"Brother Lujiu!" Ye Tianyun also flashed a hint of joy in his eyes.
"Haha, Tianyun, how about it, you didn't expect it to be me." Lu Jiu also said with a smile on his face.
"It seems that I just disturbed your good business." Lu Jiu said lightly, but his eyes were flickering between Kushina and Ye Tianyun, and they were full of teasing.
"Hey, Brother Shikaku, what are you looking at? Have you never seen a couple making out?" Kushina had a smile on her face, her eyes were half-closed, but there was a cold light in her eyes.
Seeing such a tough Kushina, Ye Tianyun couldn't help but choke. The smile on Lu Jiu's face also froze, and he laughed dryly: "It's okay, it's okay."
"Hmph." Kushina snorted, and then said: "You guys talk about business, I'll go see Anko and the others."
Kushina then left the camp.
"This Kushina..." Ye Tianyun sighed, shook his head helplessly, and then a smile appeared on his face, and he said softly: "Brother Lujiu must have done a lot of homework this time."
"Haha." Nara Shikaku laughed, and then said: "As expected of Shadow Butterfly, he hit the nail on the head."
Ye Tianyun smiled and shook his head, with a self-deprecating look on his face and a hint of helplessness in his tone: "Let me carry out a top-secret mission and kill the enemy's strong men. I have no problem. But if I are asked to command a large force of ninjas to fight, and if I fight with less and more, I have no choice but to break into the enemy camp alone."
"In terms of combat power, I am stronger than Brother Shikaku, but in terms of command ability, I am far inferior to you."
Lu Jiu was not a pretentious person, so he smiled lightly and accepted it.
"Oh, Tengumo, Minato, I'm here to help you, but the village is busy right now, because according to the intelligence, the Kumo ninja are also restless. In order to prevent the shortage of manpower due to lack of preparation when fighting the Sand ninja, Lord Hokage has already started to prepare for the battle with the Kumo ninja."
"However, Hokage-sama is still worried about you, so I was sent here when I just finished taking care of the clan's affairs."
Ye Tianyun sighed lightly, but still smiled: "Of course it is, but with Brother Lujiu, we can also be said to have strong reinforcements."
